title: Woo$kee's "Move On" is everything music is about and why people fall in love with music
htmlContent:
Woo$kee's "Move On" is everything music is about and why people fall in love with music. It connects to you and makes you feel something whether it’s your current mood or not. This song is pure brilliance and makes you want to hear more from this talented artist.

Woo$kee is able to take his own story and make it relatable for the masses on this incredible record ,that grabs you in so major you feel that he’s writing the soundtrack to your most vulnerable thoughts.
